title: Hampstead Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency hospitals, urgent care units, topographic risks, and essential supplies for Hampstead.
content:
For life-threatening medical emergencies, dial 999 or 112 immediately.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals:
- Royal Free Hospital: Pond Street, London NW3 2QG. 24-hour emergency department. From Hampstead Heath station: ~3 min walk south on South End Road into Pond Street (approx. 200 metres). From Hampstead tube station: ~15 min walk southeast via Downshire Hill and Rosslyn Hill, or bus 46 or 268 east to Pond Street. From Belsize Park station: ~10 min walk north along Haverstock Hill and Pond Street.
- St Mary's Hospital: Praed Street, London W2 1NY. Nearest designated Major Trauma Centre.

2. Urgent Treatment Centres:
- Royal Free Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre: Pond Street, London NW3 2QG. Located on the ground level adjacent to the main A&E entrance. From Finchley Road station: bus 13 south to Swiss Cottage, then bus C11 east to Royal Free.

3. Local Hazard Notes:
- Hampstead Heath features high-volume reservoirs and swimming ponds forming the headwaters of the subterranean River Fleet; steep slopes can generate dangerous high-velocity surface water runoff during severe cloudbursts.

4. Essential Supplies:
- Pharmacies and grocery supermarkets along Hampstead High Street, Heath Street, and Finchley Road supply clean water, battery packs, first-aid kits, and medicine.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
